$comment: Garbage rows sent to the opponent, indexed by lines cleared (0..4). Single source of truth:
src/versus/garbage.ts attackRowsFromClear() and the AssemblyScript bot both read this file.
none      = plain clear; tSpinMini / tSpin = clear completed by a T-spin (mini / full).
A mini T-spin only has its own entries for 1 and 2 lines; 3 and 4 fall through to the plain table,
and a full T-spin sends 6 for anything >= 3 lines (matching the original if-chain exactly).
